title: Totem combo!
description: A simple mod that will show how many totems have been demolished in a short period of time
body: A simple mod that will display how many totems have been demolished within a short period of time, with a clean and intuitive interface: real-time counting, a configurable timer for the count window, alerts when a set threshold is reached, and the ability to reset the counter manually or after the time window expires. ReGlass mod support: compatibility with modified textures and transparent UI elements, correct rendering of the counter over any glass panels, options to adjust font color and size considering overlay effects, and an automatic scaling option to match screen resolution. Additional features: event logging to a file for later analysis, filtering by totem type, binding to a hotkey for quick access, a display-only-in-combat-zone mode, and an update delay setting to reduce CPU load.
